description_expanded: Indigo Breeze - Luxury Vacation Rental on 30A with Private Pool and Game Room Favorite Features: - Private Pool - Game Room (Arcade, Ping Pong, Connect Four, Cornhole) - 5 Min Walk to Beach More about Indigo Breeze: Indulge in the epitome of coastal luxury with the exquisite 5-bedroom vacation rental, Indigo Breeze. Situated a stone's throw away from the dazzling sands and emerald waters of Dune Allen Beach, Indigo Breeze offers easy access to sun-soaked days, ocean adventures, and endless beachcombing explorations. This spacious beachside retreat, accommodating up to 12 guests, including a guest house, promises the ultimate blend of relaxation, comfort, and entertainment. The interior welcomes guests with a generously sized open-concept living area, thoughtfully designed for group gatherings and relaxation. With ample seating, a large flat-screen TV, and coastal decor, it creates an inviting space to unwind after a day of beach activities. Nearby, kids will love the nook created just for them to find an escape!  The gourmet kitchen is a chef's dream, featuring modern appliances, granite countertops, and a breakfast bar. Ideal for culinary endeavors, it sets the stage for meals enjoyed in the elegant dining area or al fresco on the patio.  Step outside to discover your private paradise. The highlight of Indigo Breeze is the expansive outdoor area, showcasing a private pool surrounded by comfortable lounge chairs and a covered patio with a dining area and grill – the perfect setting for poolside barbecues and leisurely outdoor meals. For indoor entertainment, a dedicated recreation room awaits, featuring an arcade game with 400 options, a ping pong table, Connect Four, cornhole, and additional seating, ensuring enjoyable activities for guests of all ages. Dune Allen offers a myriad of activities, including hiking, biking, and exploration of the unique coastal dune lakes. Nearby, discover charming shops, delightful restaurants, and art galleries to enhance your coastal experience. Indigo Breeze stands as the ultimate escape for families, friends, or groups seeking a memorable beachfront retreat. Immerse yourself in the beauty of the Gulf Coast, lounge by your private pool, and create cherished moments in a home that seamlessly combines elegance with beachfront relaxation. Seize the opportunity to make lasting memories in this coastal paradise and enjoy an Indigo Breeze! Sleeping Arrangements: SECOND FLOOR Bedroom 1: King Bed with Private Balcony & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower & Soaking Tub. Bedroom 2: 2 Twin over Twin Bunks & Shared Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 3: King Bed with Shared Balcony & Shared Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 4: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Additional Arrangements: Queen Sleeper Sofa GUEST HOUSE Bedroom 5: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower.  Additional Arrangements: Queen Sleeper Sofa
